answer: Retiring one verified carbon credit makes each extra identity pay $6.34, the 2024 market average per tonne; a farm running N fakes pays N×$6.34 and cannot share it because each serial retires once and the registry marks it spent forever. A farm reusing one retired serial dies by registry check at 2: the second filing shows the same serial and voids both seats. Credits come from canyon pine stands, vineyard trellis rows, and timber lots; 202 million tonnes retired in 2024, so 500 seats need 500 serials and $3,170 burned before one fake earns.
